{{Top|leg}}
'''Trinary''' was a machine [[Language/Legends|language]] used by the [[Brrbrlpp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esfandia/Legends|Esfandia]]. It was taught to them prior to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] by [[Si]], the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Esfandia Long-Range Communications Base]], who surmised that the [[Species/Legends|species]] had a unique culture while he studied them during his off-hours. As it was easier for the base's crew to understand than the Brrbrlpp's [[Brrbrlpp language|native tongue]], the Brrbrlpp began communicating with the crew using trinary, keeping the crew informed of their whereabouts and movements at all times in order to prevent accidental [[Death/Legends|deaths]].<ref name="fh3">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trinary was created by [[Sean Williams]] for the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]'', which he authored along with [[Shane Dix]]. Williams was surprised to learn that the language did not already exist in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], and when asked in an interview to explain it, stated that it was "like [[Binary/Legends|binary]] but with three digits instead of two."<ref name="interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/jedicouncil/interview/williamsdix2.asp|text=Star Wars Q&A with Sean Williams & Shane Dix - Co-Authors of NJO Force Heretic Trilogy|work=TheForce.Net|archivedate=20170905001744}}</ref>
